steps.text: Assumptions: point molecules, no intermolecular forces, perfectly elastic collisions.
Gas pressure arises from molecules colliding with the walls.
pV = nRT and pV = NkT; temperature must be in kelvin.
For a fixed amount of gas, pV/T is constant.
Kinetic theory: mean kinetic energy ∝ absolute temperature.
Heating a fixed volume raises pressure; heating at fixed pressure raises volume.
